_meta.purpose: Settings-page ruleset scoping: pick a jurisdiction -> app applies the right standards stack. Extends the existing UAE->AAOIFI+CBUAE filter to a full map.
_meta.sources: AAOIFI official adoption page (aaoifi.com/adoption-of-aaoifi-standards, read 2026-07-18) + documents verified in this project (CBUAE SG standard, SAMA SGF, BNM PDs, SBP compendium reference)
_meta.assurance_note: tier = mandatory / basis (national standards built on AAOIFI) / voluntary / own_regime. Every entry cites its source. needs_check where unconfirmed.
_meta.ui_rule: Jurisdiction selection filters WHICH standards vet a document. Default = 'AAOIFI (international)'. Multi-select allowed for cross-border deals.

rows.name: Bahrain
rows.note: AAOIFI home jurisdiction; Shari'ah + accounting + governance mandatory.

rows.name: UAE
rows.note: CBUAE adopted AAOIFI (HSA recommendation, effective Sep 2018); HSA resolutions sit ON TOP — two-tier model, confirmed in CBUAE SG text.
rows.source: AAOIFI adoption page + CBUAE_EN_2825 read verbatim + 2018 adoption pronouncement

rows.name: Saudi Arabia
rows.note: SAMA Shariah Governance Framework governs; AAOIFI followed voluntarily by institutions.
rows.source: SAMA_EN_2274 read verbatim + AAOIFI page (voluntary list)

rows.name: Malaysia
rows.note: BNM SAC rulings binding; own contract PDs (14); SC governs capital market — the bay' al-dayn divergence jurisdiction.
rows.source: BNM PDs read verbatim; SC docs pending download
